result.reason: The operative language gives Company a 30-day written termination-for-convenience right covering the Agreement and any SOW, requires return of prepaid fees attributable to the post-termination period, and prohibits early-termination charges. Contractor cannot terminate while an SOW remains uncompleted and may terminate only between SOWs on 90 days' notice, consistent with allowing no vendor convenience termination during a committed engagement. The revisions are targeted and preserve the Agreement's otherwise indefinite term. Drafting is professional, though stating that the refund is calculated expressly on a pro-rata basis and requiring Contractor's notice to be written would improve precision.
